caption: The drawing depicts a single figure dressed in a black and white garment resembling a nun's habit, with a white face, red cheeks, red lips, and black outlined eyes and mouth. The background is a brownish wood texture bordered by a uneven, rectangular red frame. The figure is holding a red heart shape at chest level with both hands, and a white, curved staff or crozier in the right hand, extending vertically to the upper right corner of the drawing. The lower portion of the habit is dark, and near the bottom center there appears to be a circular, brownish pattern. The overall colors are predominantly black, white, red, brown, and beige. The name "EMILE CERO" is written in small black text in the lower right corner.
title: Santo Retablo
